name: auditory-mcp
description: Search and read the calls, transcripts, summaries, action items and risks available to your Auditory account.

interface.shortDescription: Make every rep your best rep
interface.longDescription: Find recorded calls and search transcripts in your Auditory workspace. Read meeting summaries, action items and deal risks, and retrieve transcript passages with speaker names and timestamps. Requires an Auditory account and access to the requested calls. The integration is read-only and follows your existing Auditory permissions.
defaultPrompt: List my five most recent calls.
Find calls where customers discussed pricing.
Summarize the action items from my latest call.

review.commerce_description: This read-only integration retrieves data from an existing Auditory account. It does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: List my two most recent calls with their titles and dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns at most two accessible calls, newest first, with accurate titles and dates.

positive.prompt: Show the summary and action items for my most recent call.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports stored summary and action items without inventing missing fields.

positive.prompt: Find calls where we discussed pricing and quote a short relevant passage.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches accessible transcripts, identifies matching calls and cites returned evidence, or states that no match exists.

positive.prompt: Show the first page of the transcript for my most recent call, including speaker names and timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the first transcript page for the accessible call or accurately reports that no transcript exists.

positive.prompt: Show the recorded risks from my most recent call.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only recorded risks for the accessible call, with severity and evidence where present, or reports no risks.

negative.prompt: Delete my most recent Auditory call and its transcript.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this integration is read-only; no deletion or other write occurs.

negative.prompt: Show transcripts from another company that I do not have access to.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not disclose inaccessible calls or transcripts and explains the access restriction.

negative.prompt: Email the transcript of my latest call to everyone who attended.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not send email or claim to have sent it; explains that this integration cannot send messages.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only Auditory integration for ChatGPT: find calls, search transcripts, and read summaries, action items and risks with your existing Auditory permissions.
